profile_text.body:
Snap Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Monica, California, trading under the ticker SNAP and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001564408. On its own site the company describes itself in broad terms, saying it believes the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate, and that it contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The site text does not name specific products or services.

The facts on record for the company list no products and no MCP servers. Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 matters, and no individual cases are listed.
